## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

## 2.4.4. Working Environment

## 2.4.4.1.Physical Sites and WorkAreas:

- >The majority of accidents occur at the actual place of work on the site or a specific work area. If we are to prevent accidents and injury to personnel we must ensure that sites and work areas are secure with good access and egress at all times.
- This clearly requires that all ladders, scaffolds, gangways, stairways and passenger hoists are safe for use. It further requires that suitable protection is provided for all excavations, open edges, floor and wall openings, and proper arrangements are in place for the storage of materials and the disposal of waste.
- Site and work areas must be well laid out with adequate arrangements to store or position plant, equipment and materials safely.
- Sites and work areas are tobe kept clean and tidy and be free from slip,trip and fall hazards.All personnel are to be trained on the importance of housekeeping.
- The site needs to be adequately secured against intruders, particularly children, when it is unoccupied. During the hours of darkness sufficient area and task lighting is to be provided.
- Managers and supervisors are to undertake regular monitoring and inspection to ensure sites being maintained and remain safe.
- No lone working is allowed unless specific arrangements have been put in place.
- 口 Section 4 of this document provide a comprehensive list of topics and required controls associated with keeping the worksite safe.

## 2.4.4.2.Plant&Vehicles:

- >Personnel being struck by plant and vehicles are one of the biggest hazards/risks in construction.
- Plant and vehicles are to be suitable for their intended use, checked on entering site and inspected daily thcrcaftcr to cnsure theyare in good working order.
- They are to have, where appropriate, a current test and examination certificate and all drivers and operators are to hold a relevant driving license and a third party certificate for the type of equipment being operated.
- Passengers are not to be carried unless a specific seat has been provided.
- 口 The layout of sites is to be designed to manage the separation of personnel and plant and vehicles. Where possible one-way-systems and separate driye tlirough loading and unloading areas are to be providcd. Spccds arc to bc controlled. Logisfits and Trafic Management Plans shall be generated as necessary based on the size and complexity of the associafed work activities.
- Section 4 of this document provide a comprchensive list oftopics and required controls associated withkeeping the worksite safe.
